notes.title: MINISTRY OF TRUTH: 1984 on Steam
notes.content:
Greetings, citizen! You have joined the False Memory Dept. community. 

Active project: MINISTRY OF TRUTH: 1984
Description: Political simulator of a totalitarian society
Source: manual #1984 issued by J. Orwell
Expected release date: 3rd quarter of 2025

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45614063/5cce3043d6e73206e9f7c793d2f7ef99aa99dbed.png[/img]

Notes: 
- Story-oriented experience
- Unique thought control system
- Lots of puzzles and mini-games
- Choice-matter actions
- Multiple endings

[b]Required action to perform: add game to wishlist.[/b]
Remember, Big Brother is watching you!
